lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in at least four distinct horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns across the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal ridges to form a checkerboard-like grid, with high-intensity blobs positioned at the nodes of these intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features running parallel along the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow transition from top to bottom.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of small, elongated, low-contrast silhouettes situated ventrally posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.
